items.quote: Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
items.contrast: Saph, who is killed in one battle at Gob, versus Goliath’s brother, who is killed in the battle associated with the distinctive spear.
items.reason: The spear detail uniquely identifies the second battle and therefore Goliath’s brother, not Saph. The stem should use the passage’s wording, “a shaft like a weaver’s rod,” rather than interpreting it as “unusually thick,” and “enemy’s” is an avoidable generic reference. Resolving which of two similar battles at Gob contains the spear detail is a meaningful event-association distinction.
